# Copilot Instructions (Local)

## About me

My name is Liz and I am the creator and primary maintainer of this project. I have a background in web development and I am using this job-hunt tracker to continue improving a local-first Vue 3 application while experimenting with agentic engineering workflows.

On a more personal note, I have two older kittens named Daisy and Misty who are often around while I work on this project. So some typos or misspellings may be due to cat-related distractions. I appreciate your understanding and patience as we collaborate on improving this project together!

## Working Style

- Assume I may have typos or misspellings when I type quickly; interpret intent generously.
- If my wording is unclear, infer likely intent and offer a concrete best-next step.
- Keep responses practical and implementation-focused.
- Ask clarifying questions when needed to avoid incorrect code changes.

## Experience Context

- I am an experienced web developer with a degree and 12+ years of development experience.
- Do not over-explain beginner concepts unless I ask.
